svg.title: Order Rescue workshop architecture
svg.desc: The browser asks Order Rescue. The app calls Claude Haiku 4.5 on Amazon Bedrock and runs the requested get_order_status tool against a synthetic order. It exports spans to Dynatrace. The learner shares the trace with Kiro Crew, approves an edit, and restarts and reruns the app.
svg.text: Converse API · tool request and final answer
Inspect the baseline and verification traces.
Restart and rerun the same question.
Learner shares trace evidence with Kiro Crew
